# Bervic Invitations (www.bervic.in)

> Bervic is a premier Indian digital invitation platform and print studio for weddings, birthdays, religious functions (Puja, Griha Pravesh), and milestone celebrations. It enables users to create high-resolution interactive digital invitation web pages, automated RSVP tracking systems, custom Instagram announcement cards, and order luxury physical printed wedding cards.

## Core Capabilities & Features

- **Interactive Digital Invitations:** Dynamic web invitations featuring love stories, day-by-day event itineraries, venue map locations, photo galleries, background music player, and RSVP management.
- **Physical Invitation Cards & Return Gifts Shop (`/shop`):** 250+ handcrafted physical invitation cards across Royal & Heritage, Floral & Botanical, Vintage Parchment, Modern Die-Cut Arch, and Luxury Velvet suites on premium 350 GSM cardstock with real gold foil stamping, plus festive brass diyas and sweet hampers with doorstep delivery across India.
- **Instant WhatsApp Sharing:** Share personalized invitation links directly on WhatsApp, email, or social media without heavy PDF downloads.
- **31+ Premium Template Themes:** Handcrafted Indian wedding and event designs (Royal Gold, Botanical Luxe, Traditional Maroon, Boho Chic, Cinematic Modern).
- **Instagram Card Studio (`/cards`):** High-resolution (1080x1080px) Instagram & WhatsApp Status announcement card generator with 31+ design presets and custom photo uploader.
- **Real-Time Live Customizer:** Interactive builder with live visual preview, customizable typography, color palettes, and event section toggles.
- **Automated RSVP & Guest List:** Unique guest codes, attendance tracking, dietary preferences counter, and check-in metrics.

## Pricing & Plans

- **Free Explorer Pass (₹0):** 2 Free high-res Instagram announcement card downloads, full live interactive preview of all digital templates, and physical shop browsing.
- **Instagram Card Pass (₹99 One-Time):** 5 Extra high-res card download slots with lifetime validity across 31+ design presets.
- **Basic Pass (₹599 for 6 Months):** 1 Live interactive digital invitation website, 5 Instagram cards, full customization, guest list & RSVP tracking, unlimited WhatsApp delivery.
- **Cinematic Exclusive Pass (₹2000 for 1 Year):** 1 Exclusive 480-frame cinematic video sequence invitation template, 20 Instagram cards, audio music player, video embeds, priority support.
- **Physical Cards & Gifts Catalog (`/shop`):** Custom pricing per unit (₹10 to ₹250/piece) with tiered bulk pricing, custom foil stamping, and nationwide shipping.
